Name: Yagisan's Willy Shop Expanded
Author: Yagichan
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=5]Yagisan's Willy Shop Expanded[/size]

As your friendship with Willy grows, and certain events take place in the valley, Willy's stock selection will grow.
Stock availability may vary from day to day. This depends on your daily luck.
